units.source_text: 一天，全专人员去割草时，发现这闲寂的山寺里出现了一只猫。

en.t: One day, when the Zen trainees went out to cut grass, they discovered that a cat had appeared in the quiet mountain temple.

units.source_text: 众人出于好奇，追赶着这只小猫，并把它逮住了，于是，引起了东西两堂的争执。

en.t: Out of curiosity, everyone chased after the little cat and caught it, and this led to a dispute between the eastern and western halls.

units.source_text: 这是因为两堂都想把这只小猫放在自己的寝床上而引起争执。

en.t: The quarrel arose because both halls wanted to keep the little cat on their own sleeping platforms.
